summary: Corporacion America Airports S.A. filed Form 6-K to furnish its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and six-month periods ended June 30, 2026 and 2025. The filing contains only routine interim financial results; no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or capital return is announced. The registrant is a foreign private issuer reporting under IFRS. No board actions, advisors, deal terms, or event-driven catalysts are present. This is a plain periodic financial report, not an M&A or corporate-action event.
